z (If this card is Rejuvenated during
combat, destroy the top X cards of your
opponent's Life Deck. X = the number of Allies
you control with “Cell Jr.” in the title.)
POWER: Return an Ally in play to its owner's hand.
If that Ally had “Cell Jr.” in the title, destroy the top 3
cards of your opponent's Life Deck.
